rulings.why: System 4: after the 4. ending's single word, the row prints a 10-word closing quotation, and its word 7 is capitalised after a comma, opening its second short phrase (the hymn's title phrase, which opens lines with a capital in every stanza) after a held note. The database's line 5 of stanza 4 (10 words) runs from the opening quote mark to the closing one, a whole join of the two phrases with the same words.
settles: 578 shape (shape2-64): the refrain after stanza 4: row 1 prints word 7 with a capital inside a line of stanza 4, where no line or sentence opens
